macroTarget.note: Trainer target for Jmo: fat loss, lean muscle gain, and metabolism support. Daily structure is 3 whole-food meals plus 1 high-protein snack.

dailyHabits: Hit 155-160g protein before worrying about perfection elsewhere.
Build meals from lean protein, approved carbohydrates, vegetables, and controlled healthy fats.
Use the 30g protein list for fast swaps when travel, kids, or work blow up the plan.
Log meals, workout, water, and weight once per day.

trackerDefaults.workoutGoal: Complete planned lift/cardio or active recovery

recipeLibrary.name: Greek Yogurt with Berries and Almonds
instructions: Combine Greek yogurt and berries in a bowl.
Top with chopped almonds.

recipeLibrary.name: Spinach and Feta Omelet
instructions: Cook spinach in olive oil until wilted.
Add beaten eggs, cook until set, add feta, and fold.

recipeLibrary.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill chicken until cooked through.
Build salad with vegetables, top with chicken, and drizzle vinaigrette.

recipeLibrary.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Bake salmon and asparagus at 400F for 12-15 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp with Broccoli
instructions: Cook garlic and shrimp until pink.
Saute broccoli until tender.
Combine and finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Turkey Meatballs with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Bake turkey meatballs at 375F for 20-25 minutes.
Pulse cauliflower into rice and saute until tender.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Chicken and Quinoa Casserole
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Turkey and Vegetable Chili
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Brown turkey.
Combine all ingredients in crockpot and cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place beef and broccoli in crockpot.
Mix sauce separately, pour over, and cook on low for 5-7 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Lemon Garlic Chicken
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot.
Pour lemon garlic mixture over chicken and cook on low for 4-6 hours.

freezerRecommendations.reason: Best clean bulk protein this week; portion into 1.25-1.5 lb bags for rice bowls, sheet-pan dinners, and grill nights.
Lean, fast weeknight protein for taco bowls, zucchini skillets, lettuce cups, or turkey chili without blowing up fat targets.
High-protein, low-fat fallback; buy only what you will use or freeze flat for fast stir-fries and rice plates.

meals.name: HT BOGO Chicken Fajita Rice Bowls
meals.salePrice: Perdue boneless chicken breasts BOGO, about $3.49/lb
meals.dealHighlight: Best clean bulk protein deal at HT this week and easy to portion for family bowls.
meals.macroFit: Lean high-protein dinner; use 3/4 cup cooked rice for Jmo and go heavier on peppers/spinach.
ingredients: 5 cups cooked brown or jasmine rice
2 tbsp olive oil or avocado oil
instructions: Season sliced chicken and sear in a large skillet.
Add peppers and onion; cook until crisp-tender.
Fold in spinach at the end.
Serve over rice with lime and salsa; keep oil measured for macro control.

meals.name: HT Lean Turkey Zucchini Quinoa Skillet
meals.salePrice: 93% lean ground turkey, 20.8 oz package for $6.99
meals.dealHighlight: Lean turkey keeps fat lower than beef while still landing a sturdy protein serving.
meals.macroFit: Strong cut-day meal: lean protein, controlled carbs, high vegetable volume.
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes or 2 cups chopped tomatoes
instructions: Brown turkey in a wide skillet and drain if needed.
Add garlic, zucchini, mushrooms, and tomatoes.
Simmer until vegetables soften.
Serve over quinoa; add crushed red pepper for heat.

meals.name: HT Shrimp Green Bean Rice Plates
meals.salePrice: White shrimp 16-20 ct $7.99/lb or BOGO shrimp bag options
meals.dealHighlight: Fastest lean seafood option this week; high protein with very low fat.
meals.macroFit: Excellent when protein is behind for the day; keep sauce light and rice measured.
ingredients: 2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce or coconut aminos
instructions: Sear green beans and mushrooms until browned.
Add shrimp, garlic, and ginger; cook just until pink.
Finish with soy sauce or coconut aminos and lime.
Serve over measured rice.

meals.name: HT Ranch Steak Sweet Potato Plates
meals.dealHighlight: Cheaper steak night than strips/T-bones while still feeling like a real Saturday dinner.
meals.macroFit: Higher iron/protein meal; trim visible fat and keep steak around 5 oz for Jmo.
instructions: Roast sweet potatoes at 425F until tender.
Grill or pan-sear steak to medium and rest before slicing.
Steam or roast broccoli/green beans.
Plate steak with measured sweet potatoes and vegetables.

meals.name: HT Pork Tenderloin Cabbage Potato Sheet Pan
meals.salePrice: Hatfield marinated pork loin filet or tenderloin BOGO
meals.dealHighlight: BOGO pork tenderloin is a good family-volume buy if sodium is managed with simple sides.
meals.macroFit: Moderate-fat protein; pair with cabbage and measured potatoes to keep the plate clean.
instructions: Slice cabbage, carrots, and potatoes; spread on sheet pan with measured oil.
Add pork tenderloins and roast until cooked through.
Rest pork, slice thin, and plate with cabbage and potatoes.
Use mustard or vinegar-forward sauce instead of creamy sauce.

meals.name: ALDI Lamb Chop Cucumber Quinoa Plates
meals.salePrice: Fresh lamb shoulder chops $6.99/lb; mini cucumbers $1.69 and mushrooms $1.29
meals.dealHighlight: Best ALDI dinner protein signal this week; keep portions tighter because lamb runs fattier.
meals.macroFit: Flavorful but richer meal; use a 4 oz cooked portion for Jmo and add Greek yogurt or shrimp snack if protein is short.
instructions: Season lamb with garlic, oregano, and pepper; grill or pan-sear.
Saute mushrooms separately.
Mix cucumber with Greek yogurt, lemon, and dill.
Serve lamb with quinoa, mushrooms, and cucumber salad; keep Jmo portion to about 4 oz cooked lamb.
